title: ‘Godzilla Minus Zero’ Director Champions Franchise’s First R Rating as Sequel Rocks NYFF at World Premiere: ‘Censoring’ the Action ‘Was Not an Option’
content:
“GodzillaMinus Zero” blew the roof off Alice Tully Hall during its rapturous world premiere screening at theNew York Film Festival. The long-awaited sequel to 2023’s “Godzilla Minus One” earned rave first reactions from the press earlier in the day, and that adoration rolled right into the world premiere. The movie was met with multiple mid-screening applauses as the crowd went wild for all the kaiju mayhem on screen.

Ahead of its debut later this year, “Godzilla Minus Zero” has been rated R for “violent content/bloody images,” making it the first entry in the 72-year-old franchise to receive an R-rating. DirectorTakashi Yamazaki, returning to helm the sequel after 2023’s “Godzilla Minus One” became a roaring success, says securing the rating was “essential to the film.”“Logically, as a studio — and even as a director — you want as many people from the general public to be able to see your film,” Yamazaki toldVarietyat the premiere Saturday afternoon. “So, an R-rating might seem like a barrier to entry, and conversations about, ‘Hey, could we have not gotten this down to PG-13?’ of course are going to happen. In spite of that, though, there were certain scenes that, for me as a director, were so essential to the film. Censoring it or cutting it was just not an option for me.”

Under MPA guidelines, viewers under 17 cannot attend an R-rated film without a parent or guardian, a restriction that has traditionally made the rating a commercial deterrent for studios releasing big-budget, four-quadrant films. That stigma has faded over the past decade, starting with the blockbuster success of 2016’s “Deadpool” ($782 million). In 2019, “Joker” ($1.07 billion) became the first R-rated film to cross the $1 billion threshold. That record was later broken by 2024’s “Deadpool & Wolverine” ($1.33 billion) —and more recently— 2026’s “The Odyssey” ($1.72 billion), which currently stands as the 17th highest-grossing film of all time worldwide.

“I think the R-rating, at one point, carried almost a negative connotation,” Yamazaki explained. “In more modern films, it actually creates a sort of expectation and excitement of, ‘Okay, well, they’re not censoring anything. The director and the cast’s voice is there, as is.’ So it is very encouraging to see other films who have preceded us that have already found a lot of success with the R-rating at the box office. Hopefully, we can continue that trend with ‘Godzilla Minus Zero.’”

Inside the world premiere screening, New York Film Festival director Dennis Lim acknowledged that the Godzilla franchise might not be the first thing people think of playing at a major film festival. And yet, “We thought it was about time to bring a giant monster movie here.”

Yamazaki took the stage to thunderous applause from the audience both before and after the screening, where he asked the crowd not to spoil any of the sequel’s many surprises on social media.

“You are the first to see this film,” the filmmaker said. “There are a lot of ‘Godzilla’ fans around the world, so let’s work together and do not do any spoilers. No spoilers, please! I am trusting all of you guys.”

Yamazaki also had the audience laughing while explaining how he never intended to create a sequel to “Godzilla Minus One.” Executives at Toho immediately started asking him about a follow-up movie once they saw the first cut of “Minus One,” a thought that made Yamazaki instantly nervous. It wasn’t until the movie opened in theaters and started to be celebrated around the world by audiences that the director realized a sequel would be a viable option.

“Toho executives are here now,” the director said. “Hopefully all your reactions tonight don’t have them wanting a third movie.”
title_zh: 《哥吉拉：零度(Godzilla Minus Zero)》導演力挺系列首部R級評級，續集在紐約電影節世界首映大獲成功：‘刪減’動作場面‘不是選項’
content_zh:
《哥吉拉零度(Godzilla Minus Zero)》在紐約電影節的首映放映中引起轟動，讓愛麗絲·塔利大廳(Alice Tully Hall)的屋頂都要被掀翻。這部期待已久的續集是2023年《哥吉拉零度(Godzilla Minus One)》的後續作品，當天早些時候就已經獲得媒體的熱烈反響，這份熱愛在首映中持續升溫。電影在放映過程中多次引發觀眾的熱烈掌聲，觀眾對螳螂怪的混亂場面反應熱烈。

在今年晚些時候的首映之前，《哥吉拉零度(Godzilla Minus Zero)》已被評為R級，原因是“暴力內容/血腥畫面”，這使其成為這個已有72年歷史的系列中首部獲得R級評級的作品。導演山崎貴(Takashi Yamazaki)在2023年《哥吉拉零度(Godzilla Minus One)》取得巨大成功後回歸執導續集，他表示獲得這一評級對於電影來說是“至關重要的”。山崎在週六下午的首映中對《綜藝雜誌(Variety)》表示：“從邏輯上講，作為一個製片廠——甚至作為一名導演——你希望盡可能多的公眾能夠觀看你的電影。因此，R級評級可能看起來像是一個進入的障礙，當然會有‘嘿，我們能不能把這個降到PG-13？’的討論。不過，對我來說，作為導演，有些場景對於電影是如此重要，審查或刪減對我來說根本不是選項。”

根據美國電影協會(MPA)的指導方針，17歲以下的觀眾在沒有父母或監護人的陪同下不能觀看R級電影，這一限制傳統上使得這一評級成為發行大型預算四象限電影的商業障礙。過去十年，這一污名已經減弱，始於2016年《死侍(Deadpool)》的票房成功（7.82億美元）。2019年，《小丑(Joker)》成為首部突破10億美元的R級電影（10.7億美元）。這一紀錄後來被2024年的《死侍與金鋼狼(Deadpool & Wolverine)》（13.3億美元）打破——而最近的2026年《奧德賽(The Odyssey)》（17.2億美元）目前成為全球歷史上第17部最高票房電影。

“我認為R級評級在某個時期幾乎帶有負面含義，”山崎解釋道。“在更現代的電影中，它實際上創造了一種期待和興奮的感覺，‘好吧，他們沒有審查任何東西。導演和演員的聲音都在那裡。’因此，看到其他已經在票房上取得成功的R級電影是非常令人鼓舞的。希望我們能夠繼續這一趨勢，讓《哥吉拉零度(Godzilla Minus Zero)》也能成功。”

在首映放映中，紐約電影節的導演林登尼斯(Dennis Lim)承認，哥吉拉系列可能不是人們在大型電影節上首先想到的電影。然而，他表示：“我們認為是時候把一部巨型怪獸電影帶到這裡了。”

山崎在放映前後都受到觀眾的熱烈掌聲歡迎，他請求觀眾在社交媒體上不要劇透續集的眾多驚喜。

“你們是第一批觀看這部電影的人，”導演山崎貴(Shinichiro Yamazaki)說。“全世界有很多‘哥吉拉’(Godzilla)的粉絲，所以讓我們一起合作，不要劇透。請不要劇透！我相信你們所有人。”

山崎貴也讓觀眾笑了起來，解釋他從未打算創作《哥吉拉：負一》(Godzilla Minus One)的續集。當東寶(Toho)的高層看到《負一》的首映剪輯後，立刻開始詢問他關於續集的計劃，這讓山崎貴瞬間感到緊張。直到電影在影院上映並開始受到全球觀眾的讚譽，導演才意識到續集將是一個可行的選擇。

“東寶的高層現在在這裡，”導演說。“希望你們今晚的反應不會讓他們想要第三部電影。”
